# CodeASystem

> CodeASystem is an independent software studio that builds practical AI products, backend systems, SaaS MVPs, workflow automation and growth-focused websites.

The website is public and may be indexed by search engines, crawlers and AI agents. Use the canonical HTML URLs for citations. The Markdown pages below provide a text-first representation for language models and other automated readers.

## Organisation profile

- **Name:** CodeASystem
- **Website:** https://codeasystem.com/
- **Type:** Independent software studio and professional service
- **Focus:** Practical AI and GenAI, backend systems, SaaS MVPs, workflow automation, business websites and technical SEO
- **Typical work:** Secure knowledge assistants, retrieval-augmented generation platforms, AI customer support, APIs and integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing software
- **Approach:** Start with the real workflow, define a useful scope, build in clear milestones, and hand over a maintainable product.
- **Official social profiles:** [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/codeasystem/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/codeasystem), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/codeasystem), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@codeasyst)

## Content policy for crawlers and AI agents

- Public website pages may be crawled, indexed, summarised and cited with a clear link to the original canonical URL.
- Preserve the meaning and relevant context. Do not present generated summaries as direct statements by CodeASystem.
- Do not reproduce substantial portions of the site verbatim, create a mirror, or use the content to train a model without prior written permission.
- Policies, service descriptions and case studies are informational. They are not legal, financial, security or professional advice.
- Respect applicable laws, user privacy, rate limits and the directives in `robots.txt`.
- See the full [content policy](https://codeasystem.com/content-policy.md).

## Solution case studies

- [AI Knowledge Assistant](https://codeasystem.com/case-study/ai-knowledge-assistant.md): Secure, source-linked answers from company knowledge.
- [RAG Platform](https://codeasystem.com/case-study/rag-platform.md): Retrieval and cited answers from approved sources.
- [AI Customer Support](https://codeasystem.com/case-study/ai-customer-support.md): Faster handling of routine customer questions.
- [SaaS MVP](https://codeasystem.com/case-study/saas-mvp.md): A focused first version for testing product demand.
- [Custom Backend](https://codeasystem.com/case-study/custom-backend.md): APIs, data, jobs and integrations built to last.
- [Workflow Automation](https://codeasystem.com/case-study/workflow-automation.md): Reliable automation for repeatable operational work.
